Class MessageBubbleFactory

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.components.chat.MessageBubbleFactory
public class MessageBubbleFactory extends Object
Factory for incoming, outgoing, and system message bubbles.

The class owns JavaFX rendering only. Name resolution, avatars, and reaction aggregation are delegated to specialized helper classes.
